summary: A campaign worker asks the person they helped elect to back their own run.
realLife: When Representative Jerry Nadler retired, he backed his former aide Micah Lasher for the Manhattan seat. After winning the primary, Lasher described how far back their connection went.
inGame: needs: connect earlier campaign service to the endorsement-ask scene.
gates: The worker’s service and new candidacy are recorded.

turns.what: The officeholder offers a private reference and declines a public endorsement.
turns.pulledBy: Another longtime colleague is already in the same race.
turns.writesBack: The worker can cite the reference only on the agreed terms.

turns.what: The former aide waits to print the endorsement until the retiring member’s own announcement has gone out.
turns.pulledBy: The member has agreed in private and supplied a release time.
turns.writesBack: The campaign puts the member’s name on the next printing and dates the public endorsement to the announcement.
